title: Collections and higher-order functions
hints: Look at the README's 'New syntax' table: each function is one row's tool (grouping, compactMap, reduce(into:), filter/map/reduce, zip).

Idea: group words by their first character (`.first` is optional, so give it a default with ??); compactMap over `Int(...)`; reduce(into: [:]) bumps a `default: 0` counter; keep odds → square → sum; zip, then format "key=value".

Near-answer: `words.reduce(into: [:]) { counts, word in counts[word, default: 0] += 1 }`; `Dictionary(grouping: words) { $0.first ?? " " }`; `numbers.filter { $0 % 2 != 0 }.map { $0 * $0 }.reduce(0, +)`.
